title: Compare Humming with the observed Marlin MoE backend
hypothesis: MXFP4 expert GEMMs currently dispatch to Marlin on this H200 host. A different Hopper GEMM implementation may reduce expert time at the same routing, weights and precision.
arms: A: observed auto-selected Marlin. B: explicit --moe-backend humming, BF16 activations unchanged. Freeze TP1/DP4/EP4, DSpark k5 and every scheduler setting. Confirm actual kernel dispatch; do not silently include #59488 or FP8 activations.
eligibility: Startup logs prove Marlin selection; Humming 0.1.16 is installed. Confirm that the pinned model route supports explicit Humming, expert shape 5120/2304 and current all-to-all prepare/finalize interface. Backend load and numerical fixtures precede any timed run.
mechanism_metrics: MoE GEMM and packing time per layer; EP collective time; tokens/expert distribution; HBM and available KV blocks; acceptance; qualified goodput and TTFT/ITL.
evaluation_gap: E1 and E2 already exercise MoE. Add only upstream kernel/reference and fixed real-text quality fixtures because synthetic and Mooncake performance scoring cannot detect altered numerical semantics.
limitations: PR is closed without merge; it motivates a backend A/B, not a blind cherry-pick. Author tests use an older DeepSeek V4 checkpoint/H20; headline gains are not a forecast for this host.
